Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 147. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 65 ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Instant Galick Gun and
Instant Kamehameha
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Self (150 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
This attack fully captures the strengths of both moves.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 150 foot long line must make a
dexterity saving throw or take 12d6 Ki Damage.
